newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil bolsa delays Banco Noroeste trade.
newsitem.headline: Brazil bolsa delays Banco Noroeste trade.

text.p: Sao Paulo Stock Exchange (Bovespa) said it delayed trading in Banco Noroeste shares until 1300 local/1600 GMT Friday.
Trade was delayed following Friday's announcement of Noroeste's proposed takeover by Spain's Banco Santander SA's Brazilian unit Banco Geral do Comercio.

In a statement sent to the stock exchange, Noroeste said the controlling shareholders of the holding companies for the bank agreed to sell a controlling stake in the financial institution to Santander's Brazilian unit.
The transfer of control is due to take place after approval of Brazilian authorities, the statement said.
The announcement puts an end to months of speculation that Noroeste was due to be sold to Santander.
Controlled by the Cochrane family, Noroeste is a medium-sized bank, focusing on retail investors and small and medium corporate clients.
In the first half, the bank posted a net profit of 42.8 million reais, up from 29 million reais in the same period last year.
